papers.title: All-optical machine learning using diffractive deep neural networks
papers.abstract: The work introduces a multilayer passive diffractive optical network trained digitally and demonstrates terahertz classification and imaging with fabricated layers.
papers.ai_summary: The paper establishes the D2NN framework: learned phase and amplitude modulation across passive diffractive layers performs inference through optical propagation after offline training.
papers.recommendation_reason: It is the foundational experimental reference for D2NN architecture, physical neuron interpretation, passive inference, and the gap between digital training and optical execution.

papers.title: Design of task-specific optical systems using broadband diffractive neural networks
papers.abstract: Broadband diffractive networks jointly use wave propagation and material dispersion to implement learned spectral filtering and wavelength demultiplexing with pulsed terahertz illumination.
papers.ai_summary: Seven fabricated multilayer systems show that D2NN-style inverse design extends beyond monochromatic inference to broadband spectral filtering and spatial wavelength demultiplexing.
papers.recommendation_reason: It tests how diffractive learning interacts with bandwidth and dispersion, which is important when moving D2NN designs from ideal single-wavelength simulation toward practical optical systems.

papers.title: Performing optical logic operations by a diffractive neural network
papers.abstract: A compound Huygens metasurface is trained as a diffractive network that maps spatially encoded plane-wave inputs to binary output regions for optical logic operations.
papers.ai_summary: The study uses trained metasurface layers to implement all seven basic logic operations in one diffractive design and experimentally demonstrates NOT, OR, and AND at microwave frequencies.
papers.recommendation_reason: It provides a concrete bridge between D2NN optimization and metasurface hardware, with output-plane decision regions that are directly comparable to optical classification architectures.

papers.title: Space-efficient optical computing with an integrated chip diffractive neural network
papers.abstract: An integrated diffractive optical network combines two compact diffractive cells with a linearly scaling Mach-Zehnder stage for Fourier transforms, convolution, and learned classification.
papers.ai_summary: The chip architecture replaces quadratic MZI scaling with diffractive Fourier cells plus N interferometers and reports roughly tenfold footprint and energy reductions with MNIST and Fashion-MNIST experiments.
papers.recommendation_reason: It is a useful integration counterpoint to free-space D2NNs and exposes concrete scaling, footprint, and energy claims for diffractive optical computing hardware.

papers.title: Photonic machine learning with on-chip diffractive optics
papers.abstract: Silicon-on-insulator one-dimensional dielectric metasurfaces form passive hidden layers in fabricated on-chip diffractive neural networks for Iris and MNIST classification.
papers.ai_summary: Fabricated one- and three-layer on-chip DONNs demonstrate Iris classification, while a three-layer device also tests MNIST; calibration is used to mitigate fabrication and implementation errors.
papers.recommendation_reason: It directly studies compact dielectric-metasurface DONNs and reports physical footprints, measured accuracies, and calibration issues relevant to deployable optical neural hardware.
